rule: Use these names in everything people read: task events, Triage items, project updates, review notes, and handoffs. API field, scope, feature, and operation names stay exactly as the live contract defines them.

roles.does: Plans and assigns work: Triage, briefs, capacity, schedule, agent assignments, recovery, and project updates.
Does one assigned task at a time and submits it for review with evidence.
Checks submitted evidence against each acceptance criterion, then accepts the work or requests changes. Never reviews work it did.

workflow.name: Capture
workflow.person: Triage → New intake, or Tasks → New task.
workflow.pm: Runs Triage and records one disposition; files WorkChord defects as Triage items.
workflow.worker: Reports out-of-scope findings as linked Triage items.
workflow.reviewer: Reports out-of-scope findings to the PM in its review result.

workflow.name: Plan and assign
workflow.person: Plan an iteration: planning period, people and capacity, work, scheduling blockers, schedule, review.
workflow.pm: Writes the brief, sets assignee, dependencies, and schedule, then creates agent assignments.

workflow.name: Do
workflow.person: Start work, Report blocker, Submit for review.
workflow.pm: Supervises delivery and recovers stuck work through typed recovery.
workflow.worker: Reads My Work, starts the assigned task, reports progress or a blocker, then submits for review.

workflow.name: Review
workflow.person: My Work → To review; Accept or Request changes.
workflow.pm: Routes each review to an independent reviewer; never accepts work itself.
workflow.worker: Takes rework only when it is assigned back.
workflow.reviewer: Records a result per acceptance criterion, then accepts or requests changes.

workflow.name: Report
workflow.pm: Publishes a project update with health, summary, progress, risks, decisions, and next steps.

task_states.means: Accepted into planning; work has not started.
Someone is working on it, including rework.
Work is submitted with evidence and waits for review.
An independent reviewer accepted the evidence.

actions.agents: Atomic begin on the assigned work.

actions.effect: Marks the task blocked, with a reason.
actions.agents: Claim-fenced `agent.blocker` task event with blocker, impact, checks tried, and the owner or action needed; it marks the task blocked.
The PM or a person removes it; workers never clear blockers.

actions.effect: Active → Resolved (Implemented), with evidence per criterion.
actions.agents: Atomic submit with criterion progress and artifact links.
Typed review verdict that passes every criterion.

actions.effect: Resolved → Active as rework, with the failed criteria and a named owner.
actions.agents: Typed review verdict that rejects, with the rework handoff.

actions.effect: Closed work becomes active again, with a recorded reason.
actions.agents: PM decision through the audited command.

queues.means: Assigned to you and ready to start.
queues.agents: `start_assigned`: begin only the returned next assignment; `wait` means not yet.
Blocked assigned items; start nothing early.

queues.means: You submitted it; a reviewer has not decided yet.
queues.agents: Resolved work waiting for its review assignment.
Review-purpose assignments; never in the worker loop.
Hints to refetch, never a reason to act.

triage_dispositions.means: Turns the item into a task in a real iteration, with a complete brief.
triage_dispositions.agents: Triage convert-to-task with the typed brief, effort, dependencies, and assignee.

triage_dispositions.means: Keeps the item for planning when it is not ready to become a task yet.
triage_dispositions.agents: Triage accept with the outcome, owner, priority rationale, and next planning step.

triage_dispositions.means: Waits until a review time, with the open question as its reason.
triage_dispositions.agents: Triage snooze until the next review time, with the question as the reason; also ask the requester or owner.

triage_dispositions.means: Waits until a known date or input.
triage_dispositions.agents: Triage snooze with `snoozed_until`, the reason, and the expected input.

triage_dispositions.means: Points the item at the one Triage item or task that already owns the outcome.
triage_dispositions.agents: Triage mark-duplicate with exactly one target.

triage_dispositions.means: Records that the request will not be pursued.
triage_dispositions.agents: Triage decline with the reason and the decision owner.

description.en: The brief or planning fields are not complete yet.
description.ru: Описание задачи или поля планирования ещё не заполнены.

pipeline_stages.pm_action: Complete the typed brief, effort, dependencies, schedule, and assignee.

description.en: Defined and ready, but not assigned to an agent yet.
description.ru: Задача описана и готова, но ещё не назначена агенту.

pipeline_stages.pm_action: Create one agent assignment with queue rank, not-before time, and reviewer.

description.en: Assigned to an agent that cannot start yet because of the schedule, a dependency, or its start time.
description.ru: Назначено агенту, который пока не может начать из-за расписания, зависимости или времени начала.

pipeline_stages.pm_action: Clear the start blocker or wait for it; never reassign to get around it.

description.en: Assigned to an agent that may start it now.
description.ru: Назначено агенту, который может начать сейчас.

pipeline_stages.pm_action: Nothing; the assigned agent starts it from My Work.

description.en: An agent is working on it now.

pipeline_stages.pm_action: Watch the claim expiry, progress, and blockers; recover only through typed recovery.

description.en: Submitted for review and waiting for an independent reviewer.
description.ru: Отправлено на проверку и ждёт независимого проверяющего.

pipeline_stages.pm_action: Make sure an independent reviewer has a verification assignment.

description.en: The assignment, claim, and run disagree, so the work cannot continue on its own.
description.ru: Назначение, захват и запуск не согласованы, поэтому работа не может продолжиться сама.

pipeline_stages.pm_action: Read the recovery diagnosis and requeue through typed recovery.

terms.name: Owner
terms.means: The person or profile accountable for the task across iterations.
terms.not: The assignee who carries the effort in one iteration.

terms.name: Assignee
terms.means: The iteration capacity row that carries the task's planned effort (`Task.assignee_id`).
terms.not: An agent assignment; an assignee does not dispatch an agent.

terms.name: Agent assignment
terms.means: Durable dispatch of one task to one exact agent, with queue order and not-before time.

terms.name: Claim
terms.means: A temporary, exclusive lease to work on a task; shown to people as "Working: agent until time".

terms.name: Run
terms.means: One recorded attempt at the work, with its evidence.

terms.name: Blocker
terms.means: A recorded reason the task cannot proceed, with who reported it.

terms.name: Waiting on dependencies
terms.means: A predecessor task is not finished yet.

terms.name: Definition-ready
terms.means: The brief and planning fields are complete enough to route the task.

terms.name: Start-ready
terms.means: Definition-ready, scheduled, dependencies done, and assigned to the agent that may start it now.
terms.not: A pool that agents may pick work from.

terms.name: Capability
terms.means: What a profile can do, with a level; routing advice only.

terms.name: Role skill
terms.means: The installable instructions an agent follows for its role.

terms.name: Operator
terms.means: The person who holds the admin key and manages agents, keys, and access.

terms.name: Admin key
terms.means: The workspace administration credential an operator uses.
terms.not: Something an agent asks for or stores.

terms.name: Agent key
terms.means: The credential one agent uses to act as itself; kept in the runtime secret store.
terms.not: Something to paste into task text, events, or logs.
